facility_model.service_model: Collection & delivery service coordinating repairs through dedicated specialist transmission engineering partner facilities.
facility_model.service_areas_terminology: 45 currently covered service areas / collection coverage areas
facility_model.coverage_notes: Active across Greater London and South England; surrounding/extended areas confirm collection by telephone.

tier_1_full_rebuilds.coverage: Parts supplied and fitted by Gearbox Giants and associated workmanship forming part of the authorized rebuild invoice.

tier_2_component_repairs.usage: Targeted mechanical/electronic component repairs (e.g. solenoid replacement, mechatronic module repair, single bearing replacement)
tier_2_component_repairs.coverage: Applies strictly to the specific component(s) replaced and workmanship undertaken as detailed on the invoice.

tier_3_commercial_and_intensive_use.usage: Taxis, private-hire vehicles, driving-school vehicles, multi-drop delivery vehicles, intensive commercial fleet use
tier_3_commercial_and_intensive_use.coverage: All qualifying rebuilds or repairs on commercial or intensive-use vehicles.

pricing.pricing_model: Bespoke competitive estimates tailored to exact vehicle registration, make, model, transmission code, and diagnostic findings.

turnaround.turnaround_model: Prompt turnaround with priority diagnostic teardown and return delivery.

logistics_and_recovery.non_completed_repair_fee: From £150 if customer declines repair following vehicle collection, transport, and diagnostic inspection.

capabilities.facility_delivery_wording: Repairs are completed through our specialist transmission engineering facility / engineering partner

dealer_comparison.claim: Save up to 60% compared to franchised main dealership whole-unit crate replacements
dealer_comparison.evidence_task: Collect and document anonymised franchised dealer whole-unit crate quotations vs Gearbox Giants reconditioning invoices across common VAG DSG, ZF 8HP, and Powershift repair jobs.
dealer_comparison.qualification: Industry benchmark comparison; actual savings depend on vehicle make, model and required repair scope, and could be less.

complimentary_car_wash.policy: Complimentary car wash included on return delivery for all completed/paid repairs.
